---
title: "GOV.UK brand.yml"
---

An unofficial [`_brand.yml`](https://github.com/cjrace/govuk-brand-yml) that
themes Bootstrap, bslib and Quarto sites with GOV.UK Design System colours.
This page is themed by that same file - what you're looking at *is* the
demo.

Here's a [link to the repo](https://github.com/cjrace/govuk-brand-yml) -
tab to it, or to any button below, to see GOV.UK's black-and-yellow focus
state.

## Typography

<p class="h2">Heading style 2</p>

Body text uses the plain `Arial, sans-serif` fallback stack (see the
README for why GDS Transport isn't included), with headings set at weight
700. Here's a sentence with `inline code` in it.

## Code

A short [shinyGovstyle](https://github.com/dfe-analytical-services/shinyGovstyle)
example, to show how code blocks and inline code (like `button_Input()`)
are styled:

```r
ui <- shiny::fluidPage(
  shinyGovstyle::header(
    org_name = "Example",
    service_name = "User Examples",
    logo = "shinyGovstyle/images/moj_logo.png"
  ),
  shinyGovstyle::gov_layout(
    size = "two-thirds",
    shinyGovstyle::button_Input(
      inputId = "btn1",
      label = "Continue",
      type = "default"
    )
  ),
  shinyGovstyle::footer(full = TRUE)
)
```

## Buttons

Bootstrap buttons styled after GOV.UK's: square corners, a darker bottom
shadow, a darker hover and a pressed state. Success matches GOV.UK's default
button, danger its warning button, secondary its secondary button, and info
its inverse button. Warning uses palette orange, as GOV.UK keeps yellow for
focus only.

<button class="btn btn-primary me-2 mb-2">Primary</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary me-2 mb-2">Secondary</button>
<button class="btn btn-success me-2 mb-2">Success</button>
<button class="btn btn-danger me-2 mb-2">Danger</button>
<button class="btn btn-warning me-2 mb-2">Warning</button>
<button class="btn btn-info me-2 mb-2">Info</button>

## Colour palette

Every colour in `_brand.yml`, and where Bootstrap uses it. Swatches are
hardcoded for display - `scripts/update-tokens.sh` keeps the GOV.UK token
rows in sync.

```{=html}
<style>
.swatch {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 1.5rem;
  height: 1.5rem;
  border: 1px solid #00000022;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
</style>
```

| GOV.UK colour name | Use | Hex code | Colour example | Bootstrap mapping |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brand-colour` | Brand elements, e.g. header | `#1d70b8` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#1d70b8;"></span> | `primary` |
| `text-colour` | Default text | `#0b0c0c` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#0b0c0c;"></span> | `foreground` (body text) |
| `secondary-text-colour` | Secondary text | `#484949` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#484949;"></span> | `secondary` (muted text, placeholders) |
| `error-colour` | Error messages | `#ca3535` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#ca3535;"></span> | `danger` |
| `success-colour` | Success messages | `#0f7a52` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#0f7a52;"></span> | `success` |
| `focus-colour` | Focused elements only | `#ffdd00` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#ffdd00;"></span> | Focus styles (custom rules) |
| `focus-text-colour` | Text on focused elements | `#0b0c0c` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#0b0c0c;"></span> | - |
| `link-colour` | Links | `#1a65a6` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#1a65a6;"></span> | `info`, link colour |
| `link-visited-colour` | Visited links | `#54319f` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#54319f;"></span> | - |
| `link-hover-colour` | Hovered links | `#0f385c` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#0f385c;"></span> | `link-hover-color` |
| `link-active-colour` | Active links | `#0b0c0c` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#0b0c0c;"></span> | - |
| `border-colour` | Borders | `#cecece` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#cecece;"></span> | - |
| `surface-background-colour` | Surface backgrounds | `#f4f8fb` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#f4f8fb;"></span> | - |
| `surface-border-colour` | Surface borders | `#8eb8dc` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#8eb8dc;"></span> | - |
| `code-background-colour` | Code blocks | `#f3f3f3` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#f3f3f3;"></span> | Code background |
| `secondary-button-colour` | Secondary buttons | `#f3f3f3` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#f3f3f3;"></span> | `.btn-secondary` (custom rules) |
| `orange` | Web palette orange | `#f47738` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#f47738;"></span> | `warning` |
| `white` | Page background | `#ffffff` | <span class="swatch" style="background-color:#ffffff;"></span> | `background` |
